notes.title: New Levels and Improved graphics!
notes.notes:
Play has become more pleasant and interesting!
You don’t have to look at monochrome textures anymore, now they look better in the game.
Also added a few new levels that you will enjoy going through.

With faith in you,
Ignat Cherkashin.

notes.title: Unlocked all levels!
notes.notes:
If you have win the first level, then all the levels will be unlocked!
But bonus levels will appear only after win through level 6.

notes.title: An update that will make it easier 3 and 4 levels.
notes.notes:
If you have difficulties, there are cheat codes in the game.
They are activated in the main menu ...
